title: Replace an ideal coherent check flag while preserving full memory-update branches
statement: For a fresh dual-rail plus flag and involution T, physical first-flag-spin control C_T and encoded plus/minus readout give K_l^+=(K_l+T K_l T)/2 and K_l^-=(K_l-T K_l T)/2 for every full system/bath Kraus K_l. If every intended generator preserves P_F and collective(Z_f+Z_g)B(t) is the added noise, U_H(t)P_F=U_H0(t)P_F. No bath commutativity or reset is needed, provided propagators exist.

requires: Fresh isolated logical flag plus state; the same controlled receiver involution before/after the entire completed call (source T=X_p X_q Z_a, identity on retained M); encoded plus/minus readout and off-code outcomes treated as erasures. Collective noise means (Z_f+Z_g) tensor B_M(t), with B_M acting on the non-flag bath. Include all retained memory/reference and actual finite control windows. Code-preserving reference generators realizing this specified full-call instrument, unitary propagators and valid Duhamel identities; bounded integrable D,V couplings for the norm estimates. For forbidden-effect conversion additionally require the specified pointer input/output code, trusted Bell/teleportation and record-retirement task, zero ideal forbidden branches and ONE joint full-Stinespring norm budget. SU2 subsystem protection requires its own encoded preparation/readout and singlet-controlled target operation.

assumptions: Flag-code occupancy does not certify coherent plus state, Bell-resource quality, role secrecy or trusted terminal operations. Collective-Z immunity is not arbitrary differential/transverse or target/bath protection. Differential phase theta can give sin²(theta) forbidden effect, reaching1 with no flag-code leakage. The accepted bound is not quartic full-channel/diamond error, normalized conditional correctness, availability or throughput. Per-Kraus bounds cannot be substituted for a joint Stinespring budget. Finite calibration visibility does not acquire a uniform future bath operator bound. The SU2 no-go is only the instantaneous span of27 one-flag-spin/target Pauli cross couplings; more complex encoded controls and bounded-noise stroboscopic protocols remain outside it. DFS/noiseless-subsystem and Pauli-check methods are established antecedents. No physical operation, source numerical certificate, historical originality or matched practical advantage is acquired. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
costs: One extra physical flag spin, fresh independent preparation, exchange and differential-Z quarter pulses and their inverse readout, both flag measurements, pulse duration/control calibration, rejection/erasure and reset/routing/idle costs. Source compilation retains six controlled-Pauli data gates plus two output-code gates; it assumes actual trusted finite-window controls. Every rejected Bell candidate is paid; unknown-input isolation and a uniform success lower bound remain separate. An equally informed conventional controller can implement the same construction. Source seven-program validation and64/128-dimensional residuals are reported only; current scripts/results/log/manifest were not acquired or executed.
contract.units: hbar=1 convention: Hamiltonian norms have inverse-time units; d,l,theta and operator effects are dimensionless. P,Q are flag-code projectors. Erasure probability and unnormalized forbidden effect differ from a conditional-on-success error or total channel distance.
contract.obstruction: Acquire complete-boundary collective/differential/control-noise contracts and usable acceptance throughput with real preparation/readout/reset costs. Supply an actual protected singlet-controlled target port before transferring the SU2 construction. Compare the same complete operations and information against ordinary controls before claiming advantage.

body: The flag code consists of physical01/10. C_T acts by I/T on those two paths, so accepting their coherent sum/difference gives the exact entire-memory Kraus operators. Collective Z_f+Z_g annihilates both code states and cannot change code evolution under a preserving generator. X_F=(X_f X_g+Y_f Y_g)/2 and Z_F=(Z_f-Z_g)/2 preserve the code; exp(-i*pi*Z_F/4)exp(-i*pi*X_F/4) prepares plus from01 up to global phase, with inverse readout and off-code erasures. Equality is with the specified ideal coherent filter, not with an unfiltered arbitrary channel. Finite physical target gates must actually implement that reference or pay an in-code error. Fresh flag/Bell quality, role hiding, record retirement, terminal routing, all rejected resources and availability are separate premises.

evidence.range_scope: Actual Kraus-by-Kraus full-memory flag sandwich, collective-Z annihilation, finite-generator condition and explicit encoded preparation/readout.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed intake-author mathematical reconstruction of the actual191-line proof. Derived the sandwich by two logical path blocks for arbitrary full-memory Kraus operators, both outcomes and code erasures; checked code annihilation and encoded preparation/readout generators. Reconstructed the exact offblock Duhamel integral, leakage amplitude and triangle-integral l²/2 bound with arbitrary diagonal Q dynamics, then separated the in-code D allowance. Used the normalized Bell isometry and orthogonal Pauli components to derive the forbidden unnormalized effect from ONE joint Stinespring budget, retaining the required completed-task boundary. Reconstructed the in-code phase false-acceptance witness and why small unconditional effect supplies no conditional guarantee. For SU2, the one-body flag coefficient vectors have no scalar invariant; the independent target Pauli factors force all27 cross coefficients to vanish. Verified the algebraic singlet-controlled involution and separated it from a synthesized native gate. Exact rational finite matrices and sparse Pauli commutators are curator regression checks, not the unacquired producer programs, reported numerical tables, a primary-paper priority audit or hardware validation. Actual prior U1023 governing coarse-instrument passage was read; its trusted framing/record/terminal conditions remain unchanged.
